content.description: The list. Use the list buttons in the editor (bulleted or numbered). Bold, italic and links inside items show on the website as formatted here.

ordered.description: Old setting, used only by items written before rich text. In 'content', choose bulleted or numbered with the editor's list buttons.

items.description: Old plain-text items, kept automatically in step with 'content'. Hidden in the editor; do not edit.
